about: Sonarr v4 ntfy connection (src/NzbDrone.Core/Notifications/Ntfy/NtfyProxy.cs): POST {serverUrl.TrimEnd('/')}/{topic} with an EMPTY body; title, message, priority (int 1-5, default 3), tags and click are QUERY parameters. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <AccessToken>, else preemptive Basic when both username and password are set (ManagedHttpDispatcher sets the header to avoid the challenge). Topics must match [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+.
